name: type-surface-sweep
title: The type-surface and import-hygiene clusters resolve across the shell and cobuilder-memory
outcome: The explicit-any, non-null-assertion, and import-hygiene findings clear across the viewer shell and cobuilder-memory, and each remaining any is a recorded, deliberate stub.
done_when: The catalog's type-surface row is marked resolved, and the hygiene row names its owner
Each explicit-any finding is typed, or a recorded deliberate stub that a test needs
The 12 non-null assertions clear, and the shell's duplicate imports and unused findings clear
The viewer builds and its vitest suite passes, and the cobuilder-memory hook tests pass
The cobuilder-memory structural findings move to their own program, which this design names
abort_if: A deliberate stub must stay any, and no typed form carries the same test
The cobuilder-memory hooks need a public type the hooks module does not own

min_work.note: Commissioned by ADR-0045 epic E6 on 2026-10-24. Skeletal program. Its own design mode runs when it starts. The 157 explicit-any findings sit in nine cobuilder-memory test files, where any is often a deliberate stub, so each any needs a per-file judgment, not a bulk replace.

epics.title: The shell type surface: clear the two explicit-any and the 12 non-null assertions in the viewer shell, and the 37 shell duplicate-imports and unused findings.
epics.outcome: The shell carries no explicit-any, non-null, duplicate-import, or unused finding, and the shell tests pass.

epics.title: The cobuilder-memory type surface: type the 157 explicit-any findings in the nine test files, recording each that stays as a deliberate stub, and keep the hook tests green.
epics.outcome: Each explicit-any in cobuilder-memory is a type or a recorded stub, and the hook and test suites pass.

epics.title: Hand the cobuilder-memory structural findings to their own program, and mark the type-surface and hygiene rows resolved in the catalog.
epics.outcome: The catalog shows the type-surface and hygiene clusters resolved, and the cobuilder-memory structural debt has a named program.
